name: Signature Robe (Draknava)
description: a floor-length ceremonial bard's windsilk robe of {{PRIMARY}} and gossamer-silver silk with {{METAL}} embroidery of feathers and written music, wide flowing sleeves, a high collar of layered feather-cut plates, an open front over a fitted {{PRIMARY}} bodice and long slit skirt, a {{METAL}} sash hung with small silver bells, a long hem of floating scarves
notes: Ceremonial signature robe in her element and class, worn in her Robe scene.
